description: Three-hour polling-only estimates; all additional event traffic excluded.

assumptions: Each viewer polls immediately at time zero, then at each interval in [0, duration_seconds).
Every viewer stays for the full duration; each object poll invokes one Worker request.
All requests are assigned to one UTC budget day; no cross-midnight reset credit is assumed.
extra_worker_requests is the total additional event traffic, not a per-viewer number.
Login, assets served through Workers, monitoring, publisher requests and retries must be included in extra_worker_requests; zero excludes all of them from this estimate.
other_account_requests covers all other requests on the account in the same UTC budget day, including expected later traffic; null means unknown, not zero.
A 304 response or cache hit still counts when the request invokes a Worker; no cache discount is applied.
The estimate does not measure load, latency, CPU, storage or account usage and is not launch approval.
